feature: A friend's page: Spares, Wishlist and Decks on one strip (menu and Home plan 2026-10-22, PR 7)
note: Needs SOCIAL_FRIENDS_ENABLED and SOCIAL_WISHLIST_ENABLED on, and a SCRATCH branch seeded with scripts/seed-r2-friend-fixture.mts (COLIN_PUBLIC_ID, PETER_PUBLIC_ID) plus a pod with Colin sharing spares and three of Colin's decks. Colin shares six cards (two spare, two on the viewer's wishlist); Peter shares nothing. The strip is the Collection place's own (`shares`).

shares.note: Collection, Commanders and a friend's page draw one strip.

rows.label: /friends/Colin, Spares: the strip with its figures, the share line, cards on the wishlist first and marked
/friends/Colin/wishlist: the shipped wishlist under the strip
/friends/Colin/decks: name, commander, status and count on each tile; no list, no link
/friends/Peter, Spares: a friend who shares nothing says so
